descriptionChirho: Adjective describing a person who is proud, arrogant, or haughty — used of those who exalt themselves against God or oppress others. The three clusters split merely on number (masculine plural vs masculine singular) and minor spelling variation, but all translations converge on a single meaning: Spanish 'soberbios/soberbio/orgulloso', Hindi 'घमण्डी/घमंडी' (ghamandi), Arabic 'مُتَكَبِّرِينَ/مُتَكَبِّرٍ/مُتَكَبِّرٌ' (mutakabbir in various cases), Korean '교만한 자들/교만한' (gyoman-han, 'arrogant'), Swahili 'wenye kiburi/mwenye kiburi/mjivunaji' (all 'proud/boastful'). Used in Psalms, Job, and Isaiah of the wicked who set themselves against the LORD.
